scope: Standalone target structural qualification of the existing minimal LoRa build plus its complete shared-input safety composition; not a full Watch/product build
limitations: Only the minimal production LoRa app/adapter and complete shared-input safety selectors are linked; no full Watch navigation/sleep/Quick/context/broadcast composition is qualified.

The full deployed product recipe additionally depends on exact bridge/forced-header/profile closure, product-specific compiler flags and product capability grants; it is not reconstructed or silently approximated here.
The empty app catalog is the existing development recipe, not the installed product catalog. No package manifest is emitted or altered.
Pinned Runtime loader validation checks target ELF structure and public imports; Xtensa instructions, Runtime integration and physical hardware/RF are not executed.
ELF allocation totals exclude runtime heap, stack, framebuffers and provider allocations; they do not establish product memory admission.
No product pins, firmware recipes, manifests, release assets, installation or publication are changed.

display_contract.native: Opt-in capability-sized RGB565 color only; selected by PORTABLE_LORA_NATIVE_UI and PORTABLE_NATIVE_CANVAS. No fixed target resolution is compiled.
display_contract.selector_off: Existing legacy color and retaining monochrome/paper paths remain in the same source-pinned ELF. Byte parity compares both selectors absent, not a separate product paper build.
display_contract.paper_behavior: Native selection must not activate on paper; behavioral paper parity belongs to the host test matrix, not ELF structural validation.

capability_contract.note: ui.text-input long-request support is checked at runtime; API v1 alone does not establish the long-text extension. This records acquisition requirements, not a complete deployable capability grant.

host_only_composition.scope: Host fixtures model navigation/return and async presentation interfaces; no Watch navigation or sleep bridge is linked into the qualified target. Actual host command receipts are authoritative.

utilities_source_policy: Exact --utilities-commit must equal clean HEAD; all target source comes from immutable Git objects.
